phase_goal: Close the charter loop inside the application: the operator adds an ecommerce site by URL in the dashboard, the platform runs the inspection, and an executive report is generated from the Inspection Report without re-inspecting the site. Shopify sites only until P008 lands, per decision 3A.
expected_deliverable: Local application that runs inspections on different ecommerce websites, helps fix the issues it finds, and generates an executive-ready report showing platform issues, suitable for sending to executive leadership and potential monetization. The Inspection Report remains the canonical evidence artifact the application is built around.

Phase exit needs a second independent pass with no implementation changes.

operator_decisions.summary: Ferosh decided 1A (retain all raw evidence per inspection by default), 2A (ratify timestamp-based inspection IDs), and 3A (Level 2 maturity gates broad Shopify inspections; Level 3 rendered capture gates non-Shopify or heavily rendered storefronts). Recorded in the validation strategy as operator_decisions_2026_07_14.
